minor_parser_diagnostic: Fields larger than csv.field_size_limit() produce a generic parser-level error before field-specific validation
coordinator_decision: D4 explicitly retains the stdlib parser bound and permits parser-level diagnostics; field-specific errors apply after successful tokenization
